replies.body:
Apart from maybe those official posts that staff make and just lock so nobody post retarded replies on them.
Oh and also, posts asking questions might be useful to keep around unarchived. You can search for them on google I think.



But other than that spam should be archived. Completely pointless on the site and takes up too much space that could be used for helpful threads.
